targetText: For, until the world socialist revolution breaks out, until it embraces several countries and is strong enough to overcome international imperialism, it is the direct duty of the socialists who have conquered in one country (especially a backward one) not to accept battle against the giants of imperialism. Their duty is to try to avoid battle, to wait until the conflicts between the imperialists weaken them even more, and bring the revolution in other countries even nearer.
summary: A newly victorious socialist state encircled by stronger imperialist powers must avoid premature military battle and utilize inter-imperialist contradictions.
explanation: Defending the Treaty of Brest-Litovsk against the Left Communists, Lenin shows that preserving the revolutionary state requires sober material calculation rather than walking into a military trap set by stronger imperialist powers.

targetText: Our “Left” Communists, however, who are also fond of calling themselves “proletarian” Communists, because there is very little that is proletarian about them and very much that is petty-bourgeois, are incapable of giving thought to the balance of forces, to calculating it. This is the core of Marxism and Marxist tactics, but they disdainfully brush aside the “core” with “proud” phrases
summary: Calculating the objective material balance of class forces is the core of Marxist tactics, whereas ultra-leftism substitutes subjective phrases for material reality.
explanation: Lenin exposes the philosophical idealism and petty-bourgeois class character of ultra-leftism: instead of analyzing real material and military conditions, Left Communists treat their own subjective revolutionary desires as sufficient.

targetText: For our “Lefts” merely brandish a cardboard sword when they ignore the universally known fact, of which the war in the Ukraine has served as an additional proof, that peoples utterly exhausted by three years of butchery cannot go on fighting without a respite; and that war, if it cannot be organised on a national scale, very often creates a mentality of disintegration peculiar to petty proprietors, instead of the iron discipline of the proletariat.
summary: Ignoring the material exhaustion of the masses to demand immediate 'revolutionary war' is brandishing a cardboard sword.
explanation: Lenin contrasts proletarian discipline grounded in the real material conditions of working people with the aristocratic idealism of petty-bourgeois intellectuals who despise the war-weary masses' need for a breathing space.
